key_insight: Structured concept evolution lets a lightweight LLM discover new quantum LDPC code families by mutating algebraic specifications and executable code together.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical automated search path for scalable quantum error-correction designs, including competitive CSS qLDPC codes beyond standard constructions.
method: Pair an LLM with a structured algebraic mutation grammar.
Evolve concept+program representations that modify group algebra, protograph geometry, or base space.
Target lifted-product code families and validate with decoding experiments.
evidence_signal: The paper reports discovering diverse code families and characterizing them under code-capacity depolarizing noise using BP+OSD decoding.
watch_item: Performance is evaluated in a specific noise/decoder setting, so gains may not transfer directly to other hardware error models or decoding pipelines.
paper_title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
